book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 KORIN Korin mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge amboŋga kuyarna

content: Suŋgoŋge ndo nuŋe piro taŋgo pileniŋgit
Tane teŋenmba sine tuku idusap. Sine Kristus tuku piro mbal minmba Kuate tuku pasa tugusek kuirok minig ta kile-mayokkam tuku kulat mbal mineg.
Sine piro kulat mbal sine kurauka piro ke mayebe ŋga saket.
Taneŋge ko taŋgo afuŋge ye tuku piro pilede ta ye taŋaig ŋga ta tuku idus ndawet. Ye piro ket te yiŋe miroŋ mata pile ndawet.
Yiŋe mbar afu katese ndamba ye piro mayewet ŋga iduset ta ye wam ta mbolŋge piro taŋgo kumumbi mayok nda kinet. Suŋgoŋge ndo ye tuku piro kumumbi pilete.

Ta tuku tane pitik ndo afu tuku wam pile ndaniŋgap. Suŋgo tuku ait ndo tairŋgap. Nu luka pro sine tuku maŋau kuirok minig ta ŋakmba kilŋaniŋguwa sulumba taŋgo wam kam idusde ta kilimok kile-mayokkamŋgat. Nu taŋawa le Kuate nu taŋgo yimyam kumumbi nyu kile-duŋgamŋgat.

Tira kame, kuyar pasa tumsiŋgit taŋamba tane taŋgo ande payamka ande tuku nyu te-ibeŋ ndawap. Ye tane tuku gabat ŋakmba tuku satiŋgit ta tane wam ta kila palpe ŋga sile Apolos sikile ŋgaro mbolŋge pilmba satiŋget.
Imaŋge tane magenu ŋgate le tane nane afu liniŋganu ŋga idusde. Tane wam ŋakmba kilig ta Kuateŋge tiŋgit. Nuŋge tiŋgit ta ndaŋam saka tane taŋgine miroŋ kilanu sukmba payamkade.

Tane wam ande den ndakate ŋga idusde. Tane sine lisiŋmba nyu sugo ŋak minig ŋgade. Yoi. Sine tane taŋamba mayok kape ŋga wamdus suŋgo ŋak mineg. Taŋamba ndeta sine tane ndoŋ ulendika nyu sugo ŋak minbe.

Kuate nu sine aposel kilmba taŋgo ŋakmba ŋgumnemŋge nyu kugatok patikina ŋga ye iduset. Ta tuku taŋgo ŋaigonu bale faram tuku patikade taŋaŋ eŋel kame taŋgo ŋakmba pro sine kile-ŋgamukka kaŋger tidiŋga talasiŋgig.

Sine aposel kame Kristus tuku mbal mineg tukunu taŋgo am mbolŋge ŋginŋgan taŋgo saŋgri kugatok taŋaŋ mineg ta tane Korin mbal tane teŋenmba sakade. Sine Kristus tuku mbal mineg sulumba sine kila ŋak mbal mayok kumba sine saŋgri ŋak ŋga sakade. Tane Kristus tuku mbal minmba taŋgo am mbolŋge nyu suŋgo tade ta sine nyu suŋgo nda teg.
Sine aposel kame o buk kile mata gubak ndo minmba kule parasiŋmba tawi urfunu tiŋgeg. Afuŋge sine ŋaigo siglikade le sine tumbraŋ kugatok taŋaŋ kine promba likeg.
Siŋgine waimbi piro kareŋka mundumbi nyamagaŋ piyaweg. Afu tumail pansiŋgig ta lafu ndamba nane sinanu Kuate yabaŋeg. Afu piti siŋgig ta sine ŋgan patika ake mineg.
Afu kasursiŋgig ta sine pasa bafumbi saniŋgeg. Taŋgo pino ŋakmba sine agaŋ ŋaigonu tiglu taŋaŋ ŋga pitaikade.
Ye pasa saŋgrinu kuyarit te tane kikotiŋguwa ŋga kuyar ndawit. Tane ye tuku kiŋo kame tukunu tane kile-tidiŋgam tuku pasa te kuyaret.

Tane Kristus tuku mbal piro taŋgo gudommba tane ndin tumtiŋgam tuku minig ta tane mam gudommba kuga. Ye pasa mayenu tumtiŋgen le tane Kristus Yesus tuku mbal mayok kinaig le ye tane tuku mam taŋaŋ minet.
Tane ye tuku maŋau te-purap ŋga sarsartiŋget.

Ta tuku ye Timoteus kukuli le tane tugum kaŋgat. Nu Suŋgo mbolŋge ye tuku kiŋo mayenu minit. Ye Kristus Yesus ndoŋ ulendika minet maŋau te nuŋge tane maŋ satiŋguwa le isap. Ye Kristus tuku kuasmbi tumbraŋ ŋakmba mbolŋge minig ta taŋamba tumniŋget.
Tane afu taŋgine ŋgarosu payamka sakade. A ... Paulus nu kuru-kuruka sine tugum prowe nda ŋgade ta
Suŋgo nu nuŋe nzali dubiwa le ye mine-minemba tane tugum prowamŋgit. Ye pro payamkade mbal tuku maŋau ta kaŋgeramŋgit. Nane tuku pasa ta alo ŋak e ko alo kugatok?
Ande nu Kuate tuku gageu minit ta nu pasa ndo sa ndakate. Nu nuŋe maŋaumbi Kuate tuku saŋgri kile-mayokkate.
Tane ndaŋmba idusde? Taŋgine mbar maŋau sigair-sigairtiŋmba kile-tidiŋgi e ko kukotiŋmba pasa bafumbi satiŋgi e ŋga idusde.
